COMPANY SNAPSHOT

Larsen & Toubro Limited (L&T) is an Indian multinational conglomerate headquartered in Mumbai, founded in 1938 by Danish engineers Henning Holck-Larsen and Søren Kristian Toubro and incorporated in 1946. Today the group operates in more than 50 countries and is listed on the NSE and BSE (ticker: LT), with no single majority shareholder.

MARQUEE PROJECTS

Statue of Unity, Gujarat -the world's tallest statue, including its access infrastructure

Mumbai Trans Harbour Link (MTHL) -India's longest sea bridge

Mumbai -Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail (MAHSR) -civil works including viaducts, stations and river bridges on the C4 package

Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA)

Dhubri -Phulbari Bridge, Assam -Meghalaya -India's longest river bridge, over the Brahmaputra

Hyderabad Metro Rail -one of the world's largest metro rail projects executed on a PPP basis

Riyadh Metro, Saudi Arabia -systems and integration works

BUSINESS SEGMENTS / SERVICE LINES

Infrastructure (EPC)

Engineering, procurement and construction of buildings & factories, transportation infrastructure, heavy civil works, power transmission & distribution, and water & renewable energy projects.

Energy -Hydrocarbon & Power

End-to-end EPC for upstream, midstream and downstream oil & gas, and power generation infrastructure.

Hi-Tech Manufacturing & Defence Engineering

Design, manufacture and supply of engineered equipment for process plants, nuclear and green-hydrogen facilities, marine and land defence platforms, aerospace systems, and precision electronics for defence, security and space.

IT & Technology Services

Global IT services, digital solutions, engineering R&D, e-commerce/digital platforms, data centres and semiconductor chip-design solutions, delivered through group entities such as LTIMindtree and L&T Technology Services.

Financial Services

Retail finance, wholesale finance and investment management, delivered through L&T Finance Holdings.

Development Projects & Realty

Roads and transmission assets, the Hyderabad Metro Rail project, power development projects, and premium residential & commercial real estate through L&T Realty.

INDUSTRY

L&T operates at the intersection of engineering, construction, heavy manufacturing, information technology, defence and financial services -commonly classified under the capital goods / infrastructure & engineering sector in India, serving customers across more than 50 countries.
